description_en: Retrieves the current configuration of a knowledge source without returning connector credentials
description_zh: 读取知识来源的当前配置，不返回连接器凭证
name: GetKnowledgeSource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the source belongs
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

Code.description_en: The business error code. You can use this code to determine the error type when a request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds

CreateUser.description_en: The creator. This field is written by the server

DataSource.description_en: The data source information. This field exists only when Type is set to DATA_SOURCE

DataSourceId.description_en: The DataWorks data source ID. The server uses this ID to resolve the associated workspace, environment, and data source type
DataSourceId.description_zh: DataWorks 数据源 ID；服务端据此解析所属工作空间、环境和数据源类型

Description.description_en: The optional description of the purpose

Document.description_en: The document information. This field exists only when Type is set to DOCUMENT

ConnectorType.description_en: The connector type. Valid values: DINGTALK, FEISHU, LARK, WECOM, and YUQUE. The connector type cannot be changed after creation
ConnectorType.description_zh: DINGTALK、FEISHU、LARK、WECOM 或 YUQUE；创建后不可改变

CredentialConfigured.description_en: Indicates whether the credentials required for the connector are configured. This is a read-only field and does not return the credential content or ciphertext
CredentialConfigured.description_zh: 是否已配置连接器所需凭证；只读，不返回凭证内容或密文

DingTalk.description_en: The DingTalk configuration. This field exists only when the connector type is DingTalk

AppId.description_en: The Feishu or Lark application ID. This is not the AppSecret
AppId.description_zh: Feishu/Lark 应用 ID；不是 AppSecret

SourceUrls.description_en: The URLs of the knowledge bases, spaces, or documents selected for this connector. The actual allowed scope is determined by the connector and authorization
SourceUrls.description_zh: 该连接器选定的知识库、空间或文档 URL；实际允许的范围由连接器及授权决定

WeCom.description_en: The WeCom configuration. This field exists only when the connector type is WeCom

Spaces.description_en: The selected shared spaces, including their identities and display names
Spaces.description_zh: 已选共享空间及其身份、展示名称

SpaceId.description_en: The identity of the shared space

SpaceName.description_en: The display name verified by the server. This field is not used for identity verification
SpaceName.description_zh: 服务端校验后的展示名，不参与身份判断

Yuque.description_en: The Yuque configuration. This field exists only when the connector type is Yuque

Teams.description_en: The Yuque team configuration. Each team independently selects the synchronization scope
Teams.description_zh: 语雀团队配置；各团队独立选择同步范围

SourceUrls.description_en: The URLs of the knowledge bases, spaces, or documents selected for this connector. The actual allowed scope is determined by the connector and authorization
SourceUrls.description_zh: 该连接器选定的知识库、空间或文档 URL；实际允许的范围由连接器及授权决定

items.description_zh: 该连接器选定的知识库、空间或文档 URL；实际允许的范围由连接器及授权决定

TeamId.description_en: The team ID verified by the server
TeamId.description_zh: 服务端校验后的团队 ID

TeamLogin.description_en: The team logon name. This is read-only display information
TeamLogin.description_zh: 团队登录名，只读展示信息

TeamName.description_en: The team name. This is read-only display information
TeamName.description_zh: 团队名称，只读展示信息

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the source belongs. The source cannot be migrated to another knowledge base after creation
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 所属知识库 ID；创建后不可迁移到其他知识库

ModifyTime.description_en: The last modification time. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 最近修改时间，毫秒时间戳

Name.description_en: The name used by users to identify the source

Project.description_en: The project information. This field exists only when Type is set to PROJECT

EnvType.description_en: The optional environment type that restricts read access to Dev or Prod. If this field is not specified, it does not mean that cross-environment read access is granted
EnvType.description_zh: 可选，限定读取环境为 Dev 或 Prod；未限定时不表示可以越权读取两个环境

ProjectId.description_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. This is a source location field
ProjectId.description_zh: DataWorks 工作空间 ID；来源定位字段

SourceId.description_en: The stable source ID generated by the service
SourceId.description_zh: 服务生成的稳定来源 ID

Type.description_en: The source type. Valid values: PROJECT (workspace), DATA_SOURCE (DataWorks data source), and DOCUMENT (external document source)
Type.description_zh: 来源类型：PROJECT（工作空间）、DATA_SOURCE（DataWorks 数据源）或 DOCUMENT（外部文档来源）

Message.description_en: The security error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
